o1.biggest_strength: It follows the strongest commercial signal: more sleep content, more narrator clips, more evening posting, with clear stop/do guidance and usable drafts in our voice.
o1.biggest_mistake: It is too conservative on review, treating all sleep posts as blocked until 24 November and filling week 1 with kindness, when we could run winding-down posts that avoid condition language.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Use no-review week 1 wind-down/sleep-adjacent posts, correct the review timing to allow approved posts from Monday 23 November, and make the weekly calendar a little more specific by date and asset.
